title: Word Detective
description: Unravel the secret 5-letter cipher in 6 attempts! Analyze color-coded clues, deduce letter placements with logic, and build a master deduction streak.
instructions: Guess the secret 5-letter mystery word within 6 tries.
GREEN: Letter is in the word and in the exact correct position.
YELLOW: Letter is in the word, but in a different position.
DARK GRAY: Letter does not exist in the secret word.
controls: Physical Keyboard / Touch On-Screen Keyboard: Type letters
